policy.latest: The newest accepted regular product increment is draft=false, prerelease=false and must resolve from GitHub /releases/latest after publication.
policy.draft: Draft releases are preparation only and must never be described as public or current.
policy.prerelease: Prereleases are optional preview artifacts and must never be described as regular Latest.

claimEvidence.claim: v0.2.0-poc.20260802.3 is the current regular Latest release.
nonClaims: A tag or draft alone is not public release evidence.
Calendar cadence does not determine release status.

claimEvidence.claim: The increment contains governed validation for local synthetic company data.
nonClaims: No universal ETL, MDM or system-of-record capability is claimed.

claimEvidence.claim: Published release assets are bound to an explicit manifest, byte sizes and SHA-256 digests.
nonClaims: Repository tests do not replace anonymous public asset readback.
Release metadata edits do not authorize tag or asset replacement.
